description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.
reminderText: These chances are not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9-13.name: Nightmare Dash
description:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

ub5d9-28.name: Burst of Agony
stats: +20% More Explosion Area Per Second On Ground
+20% Explosion Damage Per Second On Ground
description: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ub5d9-10.name: Soul Thief
stats: +4 Ward Gain On Hit On Recall
description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.

ub5d9-22.name: Twilight Assault
description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

ub5d9-21.name: Jagged Carvings
description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

ub5d9-5.name: Thousand Cuts
description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack, up to a maximum.

ub5d9-17.name: Cut and Leave
description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.
reminderText: This bleed chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9-18.name: Emerald Cutlass
description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

ub5d9-8.name: Umbral Remnant
description: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade. This effect can happen a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

ub5d9-6.name: Lethal Darkness
description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.
reminderText: This is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9-16.name: Bloody Trail
stats: +10% Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Slow
+3% Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Bleed
description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.

ub5d9-27.name: Explosive Blades
description:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.

ub5d9-2.name: Sword Thrower
description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.
reminderText: For subskills that scale with area such as {Bladestorm} and {Blade Explosion} the effect of this node's radius increase on the skills' area is additive with sources of increased area.

ub5d9-25.name: Coldsnap Strike
description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.
reminderText: This chill chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9-14.name: Backstab
description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ub5d9-1.name: Dawnfall
description: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

ub5d9-26.name: Precision Cuts
description: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

ub5d9-30.name: Calling Card
description: Recalled blades have a chance to create a {Shadow} at their position.

pun22-18.name: Mind Piercer
description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy restores mana. Puncture also has physical penetration based on your maximum mana.
reminderText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the penetration provided by this effect.

pun22-10.name: Penumbral Ambush
description:
Directly using Puncture causes several {Mirages} to briefly appear at either side of you, attacking in the same direction as you. These can potentially hit the same enemy.

Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has additional mana cost.

pun22-24.name: Cadence of Death
description: Every third Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and if it is a melee attack it has increased area.

pun22-14.name: Death's Imprint
description:
Puncture has a chance to apply a {Shadow Dagger} on hit.

This chance is doubled when you directly use Puncture.

pun22-17.name: Scalebane
description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance.
Converts physical resistance shred from all sources to poison resistance shred. Poison applied by Puncture has increased duration.

pun22-15.name: Inescapable
description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

pun22-16.name: Seized Prey
description: Puncture deals more damage against slowed and {Immobilized} targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: {Immobilized} targets are unable to move for 1 second.

pun22-7.name: Press The Attack
description: Attacking with Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants {Frenzy} for a short duration.

pun22-6.name: Thrill of Anticipation
description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

pun22-21.name: Debilitation
description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique negative ailment on the target.

pun22-8.name: Efficacious Toxin
description: Puncture has a chance to apply {Efficacious Toxin} on hit, causing them to take increased damage over time.

pun22-2.name: Perforate
description: Puncture has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

pun22-23.name: Sealed Fate
description: Every 10 seconds, your next Puncture {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for 1 second.

pun22-25.name: Sanguine Obsession
description:
Converts poison chance from all sources to bleed chance.

This has no effect if you have {Scalebane}.

pun22-3.name: Timing
description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

pun22-12.name: Hunger
description: {Bleeding Fury} can have more maximum stacks.

pun22-5.name: Splinter
description: Puncture has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

pun22-4.name: Stay of Execution
description:
Puncture can be charged up, causing Puncture with a melee weapon to deal damage in a larger area and causes Puncture with a bow to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

After 1 second it releases automatically.

pun22-20.name: Redouble
description: When used with a bow, Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per enemy pierced.

pun22-0.name: Puncture
description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes enemies to bleed.

pun22-22.name: Night's Descent
description: If you use Puncture with a bow while you have a {Black Arrow}, Puncture charges 100% faster and blinds on hit.
reminderText: If your maximum charge is 1 second, this will reduce the time it takes to reach maximum charge to 0.5 seconds, but you will still benefit as if you had charged for 1 second.

pun22-13.name: Shatter
description:
Puncture has a chance to shred enemy armor. 

Armor Shred applied by Puncture has increased effect.

pun22-28.name: Rapid Strikes
description: Every 4 seconds your first few direct uses of Puncture are rapid strikes, which have increased attack speed.
reminderText: The 4 second timer to reset your number of Rapid Strike starts after the first Rapid Strike.

pun22-19.name: Cross Forward
description: When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.

pun22-26.name: Mutilate
description: Instead of applying bleed, the greater Puncture consumes all stacks of bleed on the target, causing them to deal damage immediately and restoring health per stack consumed.

pun22-11.name: Bloodthirst
description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants you {Bleeding Fury}, a buff that grants bleed chance and stacks up to 3 times. Each stack falls off after 3 seconds of not attacking.
reminderText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the ailment chance provided by this buff.

pun22-9.name: Toxic Delivery
description: Puncture has a chance to poison on hit.

sync5-11.name: Umbral Execution
description:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

sync5-9.name: Lust for Carnage
description: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

sync5-0.name: Synchronized Strike
description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

sync5-18.name: Umbral Assassination
description: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

sync5-28.name: Cutthroat
description: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.
reminderText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

sync5-10.name: Escape Artist
description: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

sync5-7.name: Shadow Fang
description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sync5-23.name: Perfect Coordination
description: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, making it easier for them to hit the same target. Synchronized Strikes has additional mana cost.

sync5-2.name: Foreshadowing
description:
{Shadows} created by Synchronized Strike deal increased damage. This effect also applies to shadows created from any source for 4 seconds after using Synchronized Strike.

This effect stacks.
reminderText: This benefit only applies to attacks performed by shadows, not to Synchronized Strike itself.

sync5-22.name: Art of the Blade
description: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

sync5-24.name: Divergence
description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

sync5-20.name: Wave of Darkness
description:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

sync5-13.name: Blade Prowess
description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

sync5-17.name: Coordinated Cuts
description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

sync5-26.name: Retreat Into Shadow
description:
You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown. You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Synchronized Strike.

Synchronized Strike's mana cost is significantly lower.

sync5-12.name: Thrill of the Kill
description: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

sync5-21.name: Dynamics
description: Synchronized Strike costs less mana.

sync5-8.name: Last Call
description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.
reminderText: Targets below 35% of max health are considered to be at low health.

sync5-5.name: Crimson Storm
notScalingStats: -5% Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud
description: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

sync5-3.name: Dark Allies
description: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.
reminderText: This effect is not cumulative with other sources of additional maximum {Shadows}, and only allows exceeding your maximum Shadows up to the amount created by this node.

sync5-15.name: True Strikes
description: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

sync5-25.name: Shadow Rush
description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

sync5-6.name: Shadow Dancing
description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

sync5-27.name: Dark Passage
stats: Create a Shadow Every Second for 4 Seconds
description:
Directly using Synchronized Strike grants {Dark Passage} for 4 seconds, creating a shadow every second over its duration.

Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only creates a single shadow from the initial attack.

sync5-16.name: Harmony of Death
description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

sync5-1.name: Growing Darkness
description: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

sync5-4.name: Razor Strikes
description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

sync5-14.name: Lethality
description: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

sync5-19.name: Shadow Infusion
description: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

mush9-3.name: Bodkin Points
description: Multishot hits have a chance to apply armor shred on hit.

mush9-28.name: Giant Slayer
stats: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target
description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mush9-20.name: Pinning Shots
description: Multishot deals more hit damage to slowed targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mush9-17.name: Toxic Gift
description: Multishot hits have a chance to inflict poison.

mush9-22.name: Pincushion
description: Multishot penetrates enemy physical resistance.

mush9-24.name: Won't Back Down
description: When you are out of mana Multishot is free to use, but it can't shoot more than a few arrows. Other bonuses still apply.

mush9-1.name: Efficient Draw
description: Multishot costs less mana.

mush9-9.name: Quick Draw
description: Multishot has increased attack speed.

mush9-23.name: Keep Pushing 'em Around
description:
Multishot hits have a chance to knock enemies on hit.

This effect only works on direct uses and has a 2 second cooldown.

mush9-18.name: Rain of Arrows
description: Multishot hits in a wider cone.

mush9-7.name: Back to Back
description: When directly using Multishot, every 6th attack is a double shot.

mush9-6.name: Point Blank
stats: -25% Less Hit Damage To Far Away Targets
description: Multishot deals more hit damage, but deals less hit damage as it travels (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: It loses damage steadily as it travels, falling to its maximum damage loss at 22 units (the base distance Multishot arrows travel).

mush9-19.name: No Easy Way Out
description: Multishot hits have a chance to slow and inflict bleed on enemies.

mush9-10.name: Piercing Shots
description: Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.

mush9-21.name: The Maj'elkan Grasp
description: Multishot has increased slow and bleed duration per point of Dexterity.

mush9-26.name: Sniping
description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and arrows travel faster.

mush9-8.name: Repeater Bow
description:
Reduce the amount of attacks to double shoot with Multishot.

Additionally, Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mush9-13.name: Hit 'n' Run
description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you use Multishot while {Stand My Ground} is activate.

mush9-4.name: Readied Arrows
description: Multishot has a chance to be shot when you use another bow attack with increased chance to stun, but it costs significantly more mana.

mush9-15.name: Large Quiver
description: Multishot has additional arrows, but costs more mana.

mush9-5.name: Hang Loose
description: Multishot has increased attack speed and chance to gain {Haste} when you use or trigger Multishot from another skill.

mush9-2.name: Strong Pull
description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) when used directly, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This effect still applies to double shots from the {Back to Back} if the Multishot that triggered it was a direct use.

mush9-12.name: Stand My Ground
description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you haven't moved in the past second.

mush9-11.name: Critical Arrows
description: Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

mush9-16.name: Heavy Arrows
stats: +10% Armor Shred Chance Per Arrow Before Limit
description:
Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hits in a smaller cone and can only shoot a maximum of 3 arrows.

Additionally, Multishot hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per arrow before the limit.
reminderText:
Modifiers that grant benefits per arrow apply before the limit of this node.

For example if your Multishot would have 9 total arrows, this node will grant 90% armor shred chance even if you only shoot 3 arrows.

mush9-14.name: True Strikes
description: Multishot has increased critical strike chance.

srk21-25.name: Deadly Aim
description:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

srk21-13.name: Exuberance
description: Shurikens have a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

srk21-22.name: Bladed Armor
description: When you directly cast Shurikens you gain a stack of {Bladed Armor}, which grants increased armor per stack. Maximum of 3 stacks.
reminderText: {Floating Blades} also affects the duration of Bladed Armor.

srk21-30.name: Chakram
description:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

The Chakram has increased size and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This damage modifier is doubled if Chakram is directly used.

srk21-28.name: Jagged Edges
description: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

srk21-20.name: Fan of Blades
description: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

srk21-16.name: Charged Steel
description:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base damage is converted it loses its {Physical} tag.
reminderText: Conversion above 100% has no effect

srk21-17.name: Shuriken Storm
description: Shurikens shock enemies on hit.

srk21-12.name: Acrobatics
description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

srk21-2.name: Toxic Tips
description: Shurikens have a chance to poison enemies.

srk21-19.name: Ricochet
description:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.
reminderText: This does not enable Chakrams to ricochet.

srk21-15.name: Alacrity
description: Shurikens have increased attack speed.

srk21-3.name: Weighted Projectiles
description: Shurikens penetrates enemy physical resistance.

srk21-8.name: Throwing Star
description: Shurikens are now thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

srk21-18.name: Abrasive Arsenal
description: Shurikens have a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

srk21-6.name: Flip of a Coin
description: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.
reminderText: For calculating the damage bonus of the {Keen Throw} node this effect counts as if it always added 2 shurikens.

srk21-23.name: Floating Blades
description: {Blade Shield} lasts longer.

srk21-11.name: Behind the Veil
description: Shurikens have a chance to {Blind} enemies.

srk21-9.name: Scintillant Steel
description: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

srk21-27.name: Ethereal Blades
description: Shurikens have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

srk21-29.name: Massacre
description: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

srk21-4.name: Deep Cuts
description: Shurikens have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

srk21-7.name: Entry Points
description: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

srk21-10.name: Keen Throw
description: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

srk21-21.name: Blade Shield
description: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. All Shurikens cast this way can hit the same target.
reminderText: Granting Shurikens pierce, such as from {Ethereal Blades}, will not allow each Shuriken to hit an individual enemy more than once.

srk21-24.name: Aerodynamic
description:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

Rogue-13.name: Poison Tipped
description: You have a chance to poison on hit while you have a dagger or bow equipped.

Rogue-14.name: Sapping Strikes
description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain health and mana.

Rogue-9.name: Dodge and Parry
description: You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receieve a {Glancing Blow} when hit.
reminderText: Glancing Blows deal 35% less damage.

Rogue-15.name: Critical Precision
stats: 8% Increased Critical Strike Chance per Sword
8% Increased Critical Strike Chance per Dagger
12% Increased Critical Strike Chance with a Bow
description: You have increased critical strike chance per sword, bow, or dagger you have equipped.

Rogue-7.name: Evasion
description: You take less damage while moving (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased dodge rating.

Rogue-6.name: Swift Assassin
description: Your melee, throwing, and bow attacks have increased attack speed and deal additional physical damage.

Rogue-11.name: Duelist
stats: 4% Increased Dodge Rating while Dual Wielding

Rogue-16.name: Disembowel
description: Every third non-channelling melee, throwing, or bow attack also inflicts bleed.

Rogue-8.name: Agility
stats: 0.2% Increased Damage per 1% Increased Movement Speed
description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for one second on hit and deal increased damage based on your increased movement speed.

Rogue-17.name: Coated Blades
description: When you directly use a melee or bow attack that costs mana, it consumes additional mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Rogue-18.name: Thiefguard
description: You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

Rogue-10.name: Twin Blade
stats: +20% Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding
description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword or dagger in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Rogue-12.name: Lethal Cadence
description: Every third melee, throwing, or bow attack deals increased damage.

Rogue-0.name: Steady Hand
reminderText: Each point of Dexterity adds 4 dodge rating and improves skills that rely on the skillfull handling of weapons, such as Flurry and Shurikens.

exvol8-20.name: Tear Flesh
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

exvol8-4.name: Fight in the Shade
description: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

exvol8-2.name: Volley
description: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

exvol8-18.name: Backup Volley
description: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8-29.name: Endless Barrage
description:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but costs mana every second. It also deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

exvol8-16.name: Focus
description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8-21.name: Aim for the Heart
description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

exvol8-8.name: Blighted Arrows
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

exvol8-6.name: Silver Arrows
description: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

exvol8-32.name: Headshot
description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

exvol8-14.name: Soul Stealer Arrows
description: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

exvol8-10.name: Lethality
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

exvol8-28.name: The Hunt
description:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

exvol8-23.name: Pin Down
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

exvol8-19.name: Deadly Draw
description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

exvol8-5.name: Skystrike
description: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage. This does not scale with damage over time.

exvol8-26.name: Steady
description: Hail of Arrows lasts longer.

exvol8-9.name: Sundering Rain
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

exvol8-22.name: Arrow Spray
description: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

exvol8-25.name: Frost Shots
description: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has a chance to inflict Frostbite each second.

exvol8-24.name: Crystal Arrows
description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and effects related to slow now depend on chill instead. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to poison with {Acid Rain}.

exvol8-12.name: Scorched Earth
description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to cold with {Crystal Arrows} or to poison with {Acid Rain}.

exvol8-7.name: Condemn
description: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

exvol8-30.name: Acid Rain
description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.
reminderText: {Barrage of Arrows} is not converted to poison.

exvol8-13.name: Pristine Fletcher
description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8-3.name: Blot Out the Sun
description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

exvol8-17.name: Quick Draw
description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8-11.name: Arsonist
description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8-31.name: Venom Arrows
description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

exvol8-27.name: Nowhere to Hide
description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

dagg3-4.name: Incapacitate
description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

dagg3-20.name: Crushing Darkness
description: When you directly use Shadow Cascade it deals more damage, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

dagg3-27.name: Flow State
description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per sword or dagger you are wielding.

dagg3-8.name: Toxic Whirl
description: Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison when using Shadow Cascade.

dagg3-24.name: Porcupine's Wrath
description: {Dagger Dance} throws more daggers which deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shadow Cascade no longer includes a melee attack.

dagg3-0.name: Shadow Cascade
description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your  {Shadows}.

dagg3-13.name: Carnage
description: Shadow Cascade's critical strikes deal more damage.

dagg3-18.name: Execution
description: Shadow Cascade deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

dagg3-5.name: Shadow Flourish
description:
If you hit at least 4 enemies with Shadow Cascade, you deal increased physical damage for a short duration.

This effect can be triggered by daggers from {Dagger Dance} as well.

dagg3-21.name: Dagger Dance
description: Shadow Cascade now also throws piercing daggers at nearby targets, dealing throwing physical damage.

dagg3-26.name: Shadow Elegance
stats: 20% Shadow Dagger Chance from Shadow Casts
100% Shadow Dagger Chance from Other Casts
description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} inflict enemies with {Shadow Dagger}. This chance is much lower when {Dagger Dance} is used by a {Shadow}.

dagg3-6.name: Maiming
description: Shadow Cascade slows enemies for a short duration.

dagg3-25.name: Hurricane of Blades
description: Shadow Cascade is now channeled and throws daggers 3 times a second. It rapidly drains your mana.

dagg3-9.name: Rapid Expanse
description: Shadow Cascade deals damage in a larger area.

dagg3-10.name: Leveraged Momentum
description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% of increased melee attack speed you have.
reminderText: This effect ignores the less attack speed from {Crushing Darkness}.

dagg3-15.name: Fight In The Shadows
stats: +4 Mana Gain per Shadow on Direct Use
description: You gain mana when you directly use Shadow Cascade per active {Shadow}.

dagg3-7.name: Rending
description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dagg3-3.name: Battle Trance
description: You have more dodge rating while directly using Shadow Cascade (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dagg3-11.name: Blade Rush
stats: 15% More Melee Crit Chance vs Bleeding
15% More Melee Crit Chance vs Poisoned
description: Shadow Cascade has more melee critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bleeding and poisoned enemies.

dagg3-28.name: Shadow Step
description:
When you directly use Shadow Cascade while targeting a {Shadow} you swap places with the Shadow.

This effect consumes mana based on how many times you have swapped places with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds.
reminderText:
This effect does not occur if the target shadow is in an inaccessible location.

If you have not swapped place with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds, this effect consumes no mana.

dagg3-2.name: Shadow Torrent
description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Shadow}.

dagg3-16.name: Onslaught
description: A portion of Shadow Cascade's mana cost is refunded if directly used when you have at least one {Shadow}.

dagg3-12.name: Precision
description: Improves Shadow Cascade's base critical strike chance.

dagg3-22.name: Daggerflow
description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} last longer causing them to travel further.

dagg3-17.name: Dismantle
description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to shred enemy armor.

dagg3-14.name: Gloomstalker
description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to create a {Shadow} on kill.

dagg3-23.name: Fray
description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dagg3-19.name: Careful Assault
description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least a certain number of {Shadows}.

htsk5-6.name: Hidden Skewer
description: Heartseeker has a chance on {Recurve} to grant you a {Dusk Shroud}, up to a maximum every 2 seconds.

htsk5-31.name: Deep Rust
description: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

htsk5-8.name: Returning Darkness
description:
After a Heartseeker arrow {Recurves} at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a {Black Arrow} between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.

htsk5-1.name: Bloodseeker
description: You leech a portion of Heartseeker's damage and it has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

htsk5-3.name: Bonepiercer
description: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

htsk5-12.name: Frozen Splinter
stats: +1% Cold Penetration Per 10% Overcapped Cold Res
description: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.

htsk5-11.name: Icy Impaler
description: Heartseeker's hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.

htsk5-14.name: Blades of the Pyre
description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a {Burning Dagger} on {Recurve} consuming mana.

htsk5-24.name: Arrow of the Ravager
description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.

htsk5-28.name: Nimble Threads
description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve} scaling with Dexterity.

htsk5-2.name: Decimating Spike
description: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

htsk5-16.name: Fury of the Hunt
description:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

htsk5-13.name: Molten Arrowstorm
description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

description: Dreamslash no longer moves you. It instead unleashes a wave of damage in the targeted direction, hitting all enemies in its path. It is still a melee attack.

dr4sl-17.name: Shrouded Dreams
stats: +10 Ward Gained on Hit per Silver Shroud
description: Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed per {Crimson Shroud}, a chance to slow enemies per {Dusk Shroud}, and grants ward on hit per {Silver Shroud}.

dr4sl-21.name: Dreamwalker
stats: +1% Increased Dream Gain Rate per 2 Dexterity
description: The rate at which you gain {Dream} stacks is increased by your dexterity.
reminderText: For example with 3 points invested and 100 dexterity, you have 150% increased {Dream} gain rate, resulting in gaining one stack every 0.8 seconds instead of every two seconds.

dr4sl-23.name: Trance of Isolation
description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance.
reminderText: This node has no effect if {Apocalyptic Vision} is allocated.

dr4sl-27.name: Apocalyptic Vision
description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and frostbite chance from all sources are converted to ignite chance. Chill chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance.

dr4sl-10.name: Domain of Night
description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have increased area of effect.

dr4sl-11.name: Wounds in Reality
notScalingStats: 1% Shadow Creation Chance per Bleed on Enemy
description:
Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

When you directly use Dreamslash and hit an enemy, you have a chance per bleed on that enemy to create a shadow nearby the enemy. This effect has a cooldown.
reminderText: If Dreamslash converts bleed to another ailment, this effect uses the converted ailment.

dr4sl-6.name: Illusory Edge
description: Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dr4sl-13.name: Somnambulism
description: Shadows performing Dreamslash also use a random specialized throwing skill, consuming mana equal to a percentage of that skill's mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second, and will not choose skills that have a cooldown.
reminderText: This does not cause you to create or consume additional shadows. Effects in this tree related to shadows performing Dreamslash do not apply to these throwing skills.

dr4sl-7.name: Imaginary Plate
description: Dreamslash hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

dr4sl-14.name: Gathering Darkness
stats: +2% Damage per Shadow Created in Past 3 Seconds
description:
Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per shadow created in the past 3 seconds, up to a maximum.

Dreamslash now has a minimum mana cost.
reminderText: Skills with a minimum mana cost can not have their cost lowered below that amount by any means.

dr4sl-1.name: Umbral Recollection
description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have a chance to be resummoned after completing the attack.
reminderText: Resummoning a shadow means the shadow is consumed and a new shadow is created at its position.

dr4sl-5.name: Distortion Blade
description: Dreamslash has increased attack speed, and its mana cost is lower.

dr4sl-15.name: Recurring Dreams
description: A limited number of shadows performing Dreamslash can consume mana to guarantee being resummoned.
reminderText: If a shadow is successfully resummoned by other sources such as {Umbral Recollection}, it will be ignored by this effect.

dr4sl-25.name: Trance of Wrath
stats: +5% Dream Aura Additional Chance to Receive Critical Strikes
description:
When you use Dreamslash you gain {Dream Aura} for 4 seconds, which has a radius equal to Dreamslash's range. While Dream Aura is active, enemies within its range have an additional chance to receive critical strikes.

While you do not have Dream Aura active, Dreamslash has increased range.

dr4sl-26.name: Narcolepsy
description:
You gain a stack of {Dream} every 2 seconds, up to a maximum.

Directly using Dreamslash can consume a Dream stack to grant the attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and cause it to choose a random nearby target.
reminderText: Shadows do not consume Dream stacks when performing Dreamslash, and thus cannot benefit from them.

dr4sl-24.name: Dreamshift
notScalingStats: Can Consume Shadow to gain Dream Stack
description:
Shadows no longer perform Dreamslash.

If you directly use Dreamslash while you are below your maximum {Dream} stacks, you will consume a shadow near an enemy to gain a Dream stack and perform Dreamslash starting from the shadow's location.
reminderText:
The use of Dreamslash which consumes a shadow does not consume the Dream stack it generates, but still benefits as if it consumed a Dream stack.

Shadows are not chosen to be consumed if they are not within range of an enemy.

dr4sl-19.name: Shared Memories
stats: 15% Refraction Chance when consuming Dream stack
description: When you directly use Dreamslash and consume a Dream stack, Dreamslash has a chance to refract towards an enemy within 8 meters. This can hit the same enemies again.
reminderText: The refraction will occur even if there are no other enemies for it to refract towards.

dr4sl-18.name: Gift of Lucidity
description: Dreamslash has a chance on hit to grant {Haste} for a short duration. Dreamslash has increased attack speed while you have Haste.
reminderText: Increased attack speed while you have Haste is affected by increased effect of Haste on you.

dr4sl-12.name: Sleep Paralysis
description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

dr4sl-9.name: Grand Delusion
description: Dreamslash has increased area of effect. This is doubled when using a two handed weapon.

dr4sl-28.name: Inception
description: Refracted Dreamslashes can also refract, but the chance is halved after each refraction.

dr4sl-4.name: Deadly Premonitions
description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance.

dr4sl-8.name: Figments of Annihilation
stats: +5% Critical Multiplier per Shadow Performing Dreamslash
description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike multiplier per shadow performing Dreamslash.
reminderText: This applies to your use of Dreamslash and to all shadows performing Dreamslash, based on the number of shadows that will be performing Dreamslash from this use.

Rogue-40.name: Ethereal Arrows
description: You have increased mana and mana regen and your bow attacks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of their mana cost.

Rogue-21.name: Focus Fire
description: You have additional Dexterity and when you hit a boss or rare enemy you reduce its dodge rating for 8 seconds.

Rogue-25.name: Wound Maker
description: You have a chance to inflict Critical Vulnerability on hit.

Rogue-27.name: Storm Fletcher
description: If you have a bow equipped you deal increased elemental damage and gain {Elemental Arrows} more frequently.

Rogue-23.name: Missile Mastery
description: You have increased bow and throwing attack damage and you have a chance to shred armour on hit.

Rogue-36.name: Covering Fire
description: When you proc {Arrowstorm} you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.
reminderText: Ward is an overshield shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

Rogue-46.name: Perfect Aim
description: Each stack of Bow Mastery with {Barrage of Pain} also grants additional critical strike multiplier and health gained on crit.

Rogue-39.name: Sharpshooter
description: Chance to gain a stack of Sharpshooter when you hit an enemy based on your how far you are from that enemy, up to a maximum at 10m. Each stack of Sharpshooter increases bow damage and lasts 8 seconds.

Rogue-44.name: Death from Afar
stats: 4% Increased Stun Chance per stack of Sharpshooter
4% Armour Shred Chance per stack of Sharpshooter
description: Each stack of Sharpshooter also increases stun chance and adds a chance to shred armour on hit

Rogue-41.name: Barrage of Pain
description: Adds {Barrage of Pain} to your Marksman Passive, Bow Mastery. You gain a stack and refresh all existing stacks of Bow Mastery by using a bow attack and hitting at least one enemy.
reminderText: Bow Mastery still increases bow attack speed

Rogue-43.name: Mana Warp
description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain mana, but bow attacks cost more mana.

Rogue-42.name: Rain of Arrows
description: Adds a chance to cause a {Rain of Arrows} to descend upon your target when you proc {Arrow Storm}. Rain of Arrows is a physical bow attack that hits all enemies in an area around the target.
reminderText: Rain of Arrows is unrelated to the active skill Hail of Arrows and is not affected by its tree.

Rogue-31.name: Reflection
notScalingStats: 10% Less Hit Damage Taken With Concentration

Rogue-3.name: Draining Arrows
description: You have increased bow attack speed and when you use a bow attack and hit at least one enemy you regain health.

Rogue-24.name: Elemental Arrows
description: If you have a bow equipped you gain 1 {Elemental Arrow} per second, up to a maximum of 3. Using a bow attack expends an Elemental Arrow to deal additional bow fire damage and bow lightning damage.

Rogue-38.name: Poison Tipped Arrows
description: You have additional poison penetration and bow attacks have additional chance to poison on hit.

Rogue-30.name: Heightened Senses
description: You have a chance to avoid critical strikes and your critical strikes with bow attacks deal more damage.

Rogue-29.name: Siege Quiver
description: You can hold additional {Elemental Arrows} and you gain ward per {Elemental Arrow} when you use them.

Rogue-32.name: Elemental Barrage
stats: +1 Elemental Arrow consumed per bow attack
notScalingStats: 200% Shock and Ignite chance when consuming 3 Arrows
description: You can consume [1] additional {Elemental Arrow} with each bow attack. If you consume 3 arrows with a single attack it has 200% additional shock and ignite chance

Rogue-35.name: Fire and Steel
stats: 25% Increased Elemental Damage with Elemental Arrow
Non-Elemental Bow Attacks Generate Elemental Arrows
Only Elemental Bow Attacks Consume Elemental Arrows
description: Non-elemental bow attacks cannot consume {Elemental Arrows}, but instead generate an Elemental Arrow on use. Consuming an Elemental Arrow also increases the elemental damage of the attack that consumes them.

Rogue-76.name: Barbed Arrows
stats: 5% Chance to inflict Bleed on Bow Hit

Rogue-26.name: Prolonged Demise
stats: +7% Damage Over Time while wielding a Bow
description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). While wielding a bow you deal increased damage over time.

Rogue-37.name: Sniper's Gambit
stats: 1% Increased damage taken from nearby enemies

Rogue-22.name: Concentration
description: By default you have {Concentration} which grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you are hit by an enemy within 4m you lose concentration for 4 seconds. Subsequent hits do not reset the cooldown.

Rogue-33.name: Arrow Storm
stats: 10% Increased Bow Attack Speed with Arrow Storm
description: When you use a bow attack you gain {Arrow Storm} which increases your bow attack speed for 3 seconds. You can only gain Arrow Storm once every 10 seconds.

flur3-11.name: Strained Reflexes
description: {Adrenaline Rush} can have multiple stacks.

flur3-8.name: Bloodplay
description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

flur3-25.name: Second Wind
description: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

flur3-28.name: Crescendo
description: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

flur3-15.name: Pavise
description: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

flur3-9.name: Giant Slayer
stats: 15% More Damage to Bosses per Stack
description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.

flur3-19.name: Compounding Toxin
description: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

flur3-17.name: Vile Tactics
stats: +20% Third Strike Poison Res Shred Chance
+20% Third Strike Physical Res Shred Chance
description:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.
reminderText: These chances are not reduced by Flurry's penalty to ailment chances.

flur3-27.name: Hamstring
description: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

flur3-4.name: Kineticism
stats: +10% Chance for Kinetic Burst on Kill
description: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.

flur3-29.name: Fusillade
description: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.
reminderText:
For nodes that affect the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd arrow separately, this means that the 3rd arrow of every second rotation is replaced with Multishot.

Multishot cast this way benefits from Multishot's skill tree, but not from Flurry's skill tree.

flur3-2.name: Alacrity
description: Flurry has increased attack speed.

flur3-18.name: Reopened Wounds
description: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

flur3-10.name: Inexhaustible
description: {Adrenaline Rush} lasts longer.

flur3-12.name: Lethal Vector
description: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

flur3-3.name: Relentless
description: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.
reminderText: Multiple stacks can be gained with each strike if you hit multiple enemies.

flur3-7.name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

flur3-13.name: Boundless Blows
description: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs mana per second to maintain.

flur3-0.name: Flurry
description: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

flur3-6.name: Blood Revelry
description: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

flur3-24.name: Stolen Endurance
description: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

flur3-5.name: Deep Strikes
description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

flur3-14.name: Accelerating Impact
description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

flur3-26.name: Sap Willpower
description: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

flur3-20.name: Shockwave
description: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

flur3-16.name: Arrow Storm
description: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

flur3-21.name: Billowing Waves
description: The {Force Waves} travel further.

flur3-22.name: Precision
description: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

flur3-23.name: Incision
description: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.
